title: Extension by zero preserves stratified perfect local models
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$, and a uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ be a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. For every subscheme $S$ below use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], completed coefficient sheaf $A_S=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_S$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and ordinary unbounded category $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_S))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Identify restrictions of these coefficient sheaves by their canonical quotient-compatible inverse-image isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_U))$. Suppose a finite stratification $U=\coprod_\alpha S_\alpha$ by locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification] is given, with pro-etale covers on whose members $K|_{S_\alpha}$ is isomorphic to $A_{S_\alpha}\otimes_A^L P$ for a perfect $A$-complex $P$, meaning a bounded complex of finite projective $A$-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex, def-weil-derived-tensor]. Use the exact module extension by zero $j_!$, applied termwise, on the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Then the composites $S_\alpha\to U\to T$, together with any closed subscheme $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ whose underlying set is $T\setminus U$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], form a finite stratification of $T$. On each $S_\alpha$ the complex $j_!K$ has the original perfect models on the same covering members under the stated coefficient identifications, and $i^{-1}(j_!K)=0$, so the zero perfect complex is its model on $Z$.

proof.text: Use the ordinary module closed-complement vanishing in proEtale_ringed_open_closed, and apply exact scalar extension to the inverse-image coefficient presentation. Choose a localization representative for K. Both functors are exact, so their mapDerivedCategoryFactors identify their composite with the image of the termwise composite complex. Every term is zero by ordinary vanishing, hence the resulting derived object is zero. This is closedDerived_isZero.

proof.text: Construct the finite stratification explicitly, indexed by Fin (s.n+1), with the closed stratum first and the original open strata afterward. Local closedness follows from the open embedding and closed immersion; Noetherianity gives constructibility. Covering follows from hcover and the original cover, and pairwise disjointness from hdisjoint and injectivity of the open immersion. On original strata retain the original sieve, covering proof, perfect complex and perfectness certificate and apply the single-model transport theorem.

proof.text: On Z use the top covering sieve and the zero A-complex. It is perfect: the zero complex is supported in [0,0] and every term is a zero, hence finite projective, module. Exact slice restriction preserves derived zero objects; this follows from localizedSystemRestriction.mapDerivedCategoryFactors and the localization representative isomorphism. Apply it both to closed vanishing and to the constant realization of zero. The unique isomorphism of zero objects gives the required local model. Pair preservation with the already proved closed vanishing.

split_report.summary: Extension by zero is exact on the open slice; actual pro-etale inverse images give the open identity and closed-complement vanishing for the completed coefficient ring sheaf. Compose inverse images to restrict to arbitrary locally closed strata, transport the given local models, use the zero perfect A-complex on Z, and verify the finite stratification explicitly. No new nodes.
